source_explanations: All cattle and dwarf-cattle age classes, sheep/goat age classes, equine age classes and both height/endweight classes, other forage-consuming species/age classes and pig liveweight classes are included.
The * definition enumerates the four dwarf-cattle breeds.
The ** definition includes the captivity/breeding/meat-production and agricultural-utilised-land conditions.
